title: Planck plus BAO gives ΩK = 0.0007 ± 0.0019
summary: Combined with baryon acoustic oscillations, the paper finds ΩK = 0.0007 ± 0.0019 and calls that spatially flat to high accuracy.
body: The conclusions of Planck 2018 results VI say that, combined with BAO, the Universe is spatially flat to high accuracy, with ΩK = 0.0007 ± 0.0019. The sentence is explicitly a combination with baryon acoustic oscillation data, not a Planck-only number. Flat here means that curvature parameter is consistent with zero inside the stated uncertainty. It is a fit result.
